items.requirement: State the research question: Can a generator trained on finite image patches synthesize arbitrarily large fields of view with coherent global structure and realistic local details?
items.quote:
we aim to build a generator that trains with image patches, and
inference images of unbounded arbitrary-large size.

items.requirement: Describe the two-stage generator. A coordinate-conditioned neural implicit structure synthesizer uses global appearance and local latent variation to produce local features. A padding-free StyleGAN2 texture synthesizer renders those features with fine-grained noise.
items.quote:
a neural implicit function, termed structure
synthesizer, and a padding-free StyleGAN2 generator, dubbed texture synthesizer.

items.requirement: Explain that independent queries give consistent pixel values at the same spatial location, allowing patches to be assembled seamlessly with constant inference memory when generated patch by patch.
items.quote: synthesize consistent pixel values at the same spatial location in the implicit image

items.requirement: Identify the extended-size synthesis benchmark as Flickr-Landscape, with 450,000 landscape images, and specify that InfinityGAN trains on 101×101 crops from 197×197 images.
items.quote: are trained with 101×101 patches cropped from 197×197 real images.

items.requirement: Name the Table 1 comparators: SinGAN, COCO-GAN, StyleGAN2 with non-constant input, its patched variant, and its padding-free variant. Describe the comparison protocol in which InfinityGAN's training images pass through 128×128 before resizing to 197×197, and its test outputs are generated at 197/128 times the baseline dimensions to align fields of view.
items.quote:
images are first bilinear
interpolated into 128×128 before resized into 197×197.

items.requirement: Distinguish training-resolution FID from ScaleInv FID. Explain that ScaleInv FID downsamples enlarged generations bilinearly to training-data size before computing FID and relies on assumed landscape self-similarity because large-field-of-view real reference images are unavailable.
items.quote: resizes larger images to the training data size with bilinear interpolation, then computes FID.

items.requirement: Report that InfinityGAN has the lowest ScaleInv FID among the tested methods at 4× and 8×. Qualify the result by noting that differences in training crop field of view and resolution limit direct comparison of absolute FID values.
items.quote:
InfinityGAN maintains a more steady slope, and surpasses the strongest baseline after
4× ScaleInv FID.

items.requirement: Report that more than 90% of choices favored InfinityGAN in each reported baseline comparison at 4× and 8×. Identify the Flickr-Landscape study as a two-alternative forced choice about realism and structural plausibility, with 50 participants, 30 queries per participant, and 16 random samples per method in each query.
items.quote: the user study shows an over 90% of preference favorable to InfinityGAN against all baselines.

items.requirement: Include the reported failure modes: composing landscapes at different scales may introduce artifacts, and foliage near the top of training photos can lead to tree-like content appearing in the generated sky.
items.quote: composes landscapes of different scales together, synthesized images may contain artifacts.
